Record configuration and calibrate thresholds on separate data; do not invent platform-specific values.

Falsifiable hypothesis (per-request speculative state recycling): enabling bounded per-request speculative state recycling will improve speculative decode throughput (tokens/s) or end-to-end p95/p99 latency versus the current speculative path at a declared workload stratum, while preserving target-equivalent output quality, error rate, memory limits, and SLOs. It is falsified if the predeclared margin is not met or any guardrail fails.

Controlled experiment: randomly assign matched requests, after warm-up, to target-only, current speculation, or current speculation plus the intervention. Stratify by prompt and generated length (tokens), concurrency (requests), arrival rate (requests/s), batch size (requests), and workload class. Use repeated trials, confidence intervals, a held-out replay set, and unchanged-load canaries. Keep rollout bounded and blind analysis to arm labels where practical.

Measure synchronized per-step and per-request traces: draft latency and target verification latency (ms), end-to-end and time-to-first-token latency (ms), throughput (tokens/s and requests/s), acceptance rate by speculative position (%), accepted tokens per step (tokens/step), draft length (tokens), synchronization and queue-wait overhead (ms), GPU/CPU utilization (%), memory/KV-cache peak (GB), retries/fallbacks/errors (count and rate), and target-equivalence/quality outcomes. Compare distributions, not only means, and report workload-stratum effects.

Confounders include kernel warm-up, clock/power state, caching, batch-shape changes, queueing, admission bias, prompt mix, random seeds, tokenizer or sampling mismatch, contention, and measurement overhead. Pin or randomize these factors, log versions and resource limits, and separate draft, verification, synchronization, and queue components in the trace.

Safety and rollback: fail closed to target-only decoding on timeout, mismatch, cache pressure, quality/error guardrail breach, or resource exhaustion; cap speculative length and memory, canary gradually, and roll back automatically if p95/p99 latency, quality, error, fairness, or cost limits regress. Evidence required before generalization is raw synchronized traces, randomized uncertainty estimates, held-out replication, target-only equivalence checks, and rollback/canary logs.
